describes: OpenAI Admin API GET /v1/organization/usage/completions response saved as JSON (bucket_width=1d or 1h, group_by=model). Token quantities only: no money.

sources.covers: bucket fields start_time/end_time (Unix seconds, UTC); result fields input_tokens, output_tokens, input_cached_tokens, input_audio_tokens, output_audio_tokens, num_model_requests, project_id, user_id, api_key_id, model, batch; bucket_width 1m|1h|1d
input_tokens: 'The aggregated number of text input tokens used, including cached tokens' (read through the search engine excerpt of this official page; a direct fetch returned HTTP 403)

unverified: the 'including cached tokens' sentence was read in a search excerpt, not in a direct fetch of the page
provenance.notes: input = input_tokens - input_cached_tokens (OTK convention: input is the uncached part); cache_read = input_cached_tokens. Audio categories are outside the OTK text scope and are not expanded.
